name: Andel Deluxe Track 2.0 crankset w/ bottom bracket - black / 165mm
spec_notes: 144mm bcd
cups install using  Park Tool BBT-19.2
Park Tool BBT-19.2
includes two 1mm bottom bracket spacers (these are not required and depend on your application)
Installation instructions
Hollowtech II-style cranksets are very easy to install, following this procedure:
Apply grease to the bottom bracket threads and the frame's bottom bracket shell threads, and install the bearing cups to 5-50 Nm {305 - 435 in. lbs}
Apply a thin coat of grease to the crank axle, and slide it through both bearing cups. You may need to gently tap the center of the drive-side crank with a rubber mallet to seat it fully.

Apply grease to the splined crank arm interface and pressure bolt threads, and install the left arm using the pressure bolt. Tighten the pressure bolt only enough to remove side-to-side play in the crankset. Overtightening will cause the left side bearing (or both bearings) to bind, preventing the crank from spinning freely. If you need to increase drive-side crank arm or chainring clearance, disassemble and reinstall using the appropriate spacer(s) between the drive side cup and BB shell.
Tighten the two pinch bolts,back and forth, until 12-15 Nm {   88 to 132 inch-lbs .} is reached.
88 to 132 inch-lbs
ⓘ  Please note, you will want to re-check the torque of the pinch bolts after riding a few times to ensure they remain secure.
